svg.title: Proof. Each step is an application of Proposition 14.8 together with (TEL1); the cycle con- ditions needed for each division are the displayed ones. For (5), let Wa(b, p) denote the lift of the independent index, a the dependent and b the independent two-form index. Then P b symbol1(p)b,iWa(b, p) = Va,i(p), and contracting with symbol1(−p)a,h and summing over a gives uh,i by (TEL2). No polarization is omitted and the two momentum slots are not identified. In the many-leg construction the other independent contractions define coefficient subspaces constant in the divided block, which the coordinate homotopy preserves; for two legs that condition is vacuous.
